declarations.coverage: Drafted from the repository tree by `discovery/draft-documentation-scope.mjs`: every file Git keeps under the documentation roots `docs` and `factory/docs`, a new index for each of their directories without one, the development guide, and the domain glossaries and context maps the rules identify. Paths other declarations own are left out, and so is each README.md outside the documentation roots. Link-repair files and move destinations enter when the work needs them. Reviewed source declarations, package manifests, project guidance, the glossary map, vendor provenance and authoring decisions: `docs` and `factory/docs` are the documentation roots, as the repository conformance test's scope and the factory package's own documentation tree establish; authoring-notes.md remains beside standards.yaml as project guidance requires. Vendor snapshots, license notices, retired installed skills, and guidance/discovery source inputs are excluded. No moves or new indexes are needed.

Reviewed the root and factory package manifests, the development guides, the glossary map and vendor README provenance. The factory directory is Scriptorium, a separately released package with its own package.json, scripts, tests, glossary and documentation tree, so it is a Project with its existing factory/README.md. The root package owns all other maintenance and validation; operations, discovery, guidance and scripts have no independent Project commands; test fixtures, vendored snapshots and documentation are excluded. No missing Project README is needed.
